## 1.23.3: a quieter, smarter behaviour baseline

This release reworks the behaviour baseline (Settings > Alerts > Options) so it keeps a record of everything it notices without flooding you with notifications. It also covers the unreleased 1.23.0 to 1.23.2.

### Improved

- **Nothing is thrown away while a program is learning.** Before, a program's learning period (its first 7 days by default) simply raised nothing: new countries and networks were added to its "usual" set with no trace. Now every finding (new country, network or domain, traffic spike, unusual hour) appears in the Alerts log, marked *(logged while learning)*. These entries are quiet: no desktop popup, no unread badge and nothing sent to notification plugins. What the baseline saw then counts as usual, so the end of learning doesn't bring a burst of alerts.
- **New: domains.** The baseline now also learns which domains each program talks to, from the names that program looked up, and alerts on a new one. Hosts are grouped by domain, so `a.cdn.github.com` and `b.cdn.github.com` both count as `github.com` (country-code domains like `bbc.co.uk` are kept whole). "Learn domains too" is on by default and uses only local data; nothing is sent anywhere. A program that already uses 30 or more domains, such as a web browser, has new ones logged quietly instead of raising alerts.
- The contact alert is now called **Behaviour: new country, network or domain**.
- The traffic spike and unusual hour checks now also run while a program is learning (logged quietly), once it has two days of history.

### Fixes

- **Switching the baseline on no longer floods you with alerts.** The learning period only counted from when each program was first seen, so programs you'd had for weeks alerted at once for every country they had ever used. It now counts from first seen or from when you switched the baseline on, whichever is later. Switching it off and on again starts a new learning period.
- **"Mark as normal" now works visibly.** The button stayed on the alert after you pressed it and nothing confirmed it. It now disappears straight away and a message confirms it.
- The confusing "Baseline window" setting (`[14 days] no alerts for [7 days]`) is now two clear rows: **Learn from the last** and **Learning period**. The behaviour alert types also point to the Options tab where the baseline is switched on.
